title: B. Mex Master
statement:
You are given an array a of length n. The score of a is the MEX^dagger of [a_1+a_2,a_2+a_3,…,a_{n-1}+a_n]. Find the minimum score of a if you are allowed to rearrange elements of a in any order. Note that you are not required to construct the array a that achieves the minimum score.

^dagger The MEX (minimum excluded) of an array is the smallest non-negative integer that does not belong to the array. For instance:

The first line contains a single integer t (1≤ t≤ 10^4) — the number of test cases. The description of test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer n (2≤ n≤ 2·10^5).

The second line of each test case contains n integers a_1, a_2, …, a_n (0 ≤ a_i ≤ 2·10^5).

It is guaranteed that the sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2·10^5.

For each test case, output the minimum score of a after rearranging the elements of a in any order.

In the first test case, it is optimal to rearrange a as [0,0], the score of this array is the MEX of [0+0]=[0], which is 1.

In the second test case, it is optimal to rearrange a as [0,1,0], the score of this array is the MEX of [0+1,1+0]=[1,1], which is 0.

Input:
```
320 030 0 181 0 0 0 2 0 3 0
```

Output:
```
1
0
1
```
